title: Table 1 from rem:hecke-operations
html:
Table. Table 1 from rem:hecke-operations

The table records, for each braid word (the Operation column), its Hecke normal form and the scalar obtained by evaluating that normal form at the substrate modulus q_0 — the net(q_0) column. The final column gives the physical reading of the resulting knot/link.

Operation Normal form net(q_0) Physical interpretation
\sigma_0^2 \mathbf{1} + h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot\sigma_0 +1.209 Hopf self-link (Hecke relation)
\sigma_1^2 \mathbf{1} + h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot\sigma_1 +1.209 Hopf self-link (Hecke relation)
\sigma_0\sigma_1^2 \sigma_0 + h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot L_+ +1.209 Crossing then self-link
\sigma_1\sigma_0^2 \sigma_1 + h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot L_- +1.209 Crossing then self-link
\sigma_0^2\sigma_1 \sigma_1 + h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot L_+ +1.209 Self-link then crossing
\sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0\sigma_1 L_- + h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot e^- +1.209 Hopf chain (4 crossings)
\sigma_1\sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0 L_+ + h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot e^- +1.209 Hopf chain (4 crossings)
\sigma_0^{-1} -h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot\gamma + \sigma_0 +0.791 Negative crossing (down quark)
\sigma_1^{-1} -h_{\mathrm{A}}\cdot\gamma + \sigma_1 +0.791 Negative crossing
\sigma_0^{-1}\sigma_1^{-1} +0.044\gamma - 0.209\sigma_0 - 0.209\sigma_1 + L_+ +0.626 Inverse Hopf link
\sigma_1^{-1}\sigma_0^{-1} +0.044\gamma - 0.209\sigma_0 - 0.209\sigma_1 + L_- +0.626 Inverse Hopf link
\sigma_0^{-1}\sigma_1^{-1}\sigma_0^{-1} (see e^+ in Table K.1) +0.451 Positron (mirror trefoil)

Legend for the normal-form column: h_{\mathrm{A}} is the Hecke self-crossing coefficient (the scalar multiplying the surviving generator in each normal form); L_+ and L_- are the positive- and negative-crossing generators; e^+ and e^- are the positron and electron basis elements; \gamma is the identity element of the Hecke algebra. The bare decimals 0.044 and 0.209 are numeric coefficients in the Hecke normal form, not separate symbols.
